name: Herno Sloe Gin
base_ingredient: Hernö Dry Gin matured with sloe berries
production: Hernö Dry Gin matured 4 months with ripe sloes
Then 4 months in casks previously used for Hernö Juniper Cask Gin
history: 2011 | Hernö Gin, Sweden's first gin distillery, established by Jon Hillgren
2021 | Slow Sloe Gin released as 5th 'Interpretations by Hernö Gin' edition (1,066 bottles)
palate: Fruity, shifting from sweetness to dry spice
serve_official: Bitter lemon or lemon tonic with a twist of lemon peel
notes: POSSIBLE BACKLOG MISMATCH: only source found is the 2021 limited 'Slow Sloe Gin' (1,066 bottles, 40%), not a 2015 standing release. Retailers list a 'Herno Sloe Gin 500ml' - may be a different product [cần kiểm tra].
